defaultValue: Saved difficulty: Standard (reopen this tab after saving)

fieldDescription: Choose a difficulty for catching fish and hunting legendaries. It takes effect when you save. Choose Keep current to leave your individual settings as they are. Default: Keep current.
Fish won't escape when the catch meter reaches zero, but you still have to fill it to land the catch. Applies to your next catch. Default: off.
Choose which quest markers to show. Saving applies these choices to the switches in Quests & Markers; it doesn't change the quests themselves. Default: Keep current.
Hide rumor notifications. You'll still be told when a quest progresses, completes or fails. Default: off.
Tone down flashes, distortion, decorative particles and camera movement. Warnings stay visible. Default: off.
Adjust the volume of fishing abilities, minigames and legendary hunts. Your game volume still applies; ordinary UI and cargo sounds are unchanged. Default: 100%%.

secondaryValue: Never play, Play when relevant, Always play
fieldDescription: Play a sound when a harpoon charge is restored. Play when relevant limits this to times when your breach lamps are on or you're near an open pond. Default: Play when relevant.
Center the camera on a pond as it opens to make aiming easier. Turn this off to keep control of the camera; aiming will be harder and may cause nausea if you're sensitive to motion. Default: on.
Let the Fisherman offer to skip the tutorial. The option is only available before you start it. Default: off.
Make the catching bar wider or narrower. A wider bar makes it easier to keep the fish inside. Applies to your next catch. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how fast fish move in the minigame, without changing their speed in space. Applies to your next catch. Default: 100%%.
Set how quickly the catch meter fills while the fish is inside the bar. Higher values make catching easier. Applies to your next catch. Default: 100%%.
Set how quickly the catch meter drains while the fish is outside the bar. Lower values make catching easier; zero stops the drain entirely. Applies to your next catch. Default: 100%%.
Set how full the catch meter is at the start of your next catch. Default: 40%%.
Give yourself this many seconds at the start of a catch before the meter can lose progress. Applies to your next catch. Default: 0 seconds.

Give yourself this many seconds to recover when the catch meter reaches zero. Gaining any progress resets the timer, and pausing stops it. Prevent fish escaping disables failure altogether. Applies to your next catch. Default: 0 seconds.
Speed up or slow down the fish, catching bar and treasure together. The opening grace period and failure delay still count real seconds. Applies to your next catch. Default: 100%%.
Adjust the difficulty of catching Common fish. Higher values make them move faster, drain the catch meter faster and fill it more slowly. Applies to your next catch. Default: 100%%.
Adjust the difficulty of catching Uncommon fish. Higher values make them move faster, drain the catch meter faster and fill it more slowly. Applies to your next catch. Default: 100%%.
Adjust the difficulty of catching Rare fish. Higher values make them move faster, drain the catch meter faster and fill it more slowly. Applies to your next catch. Default: 100%%.
Adjust the difficulty of catching Epic fish. Higher values make them move faster, drain the catch meter faster and fill it more slowly. Applies to your next catch. Default: 100%%.

Adjust legendary minigame difficulty. Higher values make the fish move faster, drain the catch meter faster and fill it more slowly. Applies to your next catch. Use Legendary Hunts to adjust the hunt in space. Default: 100%%.
Set how quickly the catching bar gains upward speed while you lift it. Applies to your next catch. Default: 100%%.
Set how quickly the catching bar gains downward speed when you release it. Applies to your next catch. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how much the catching bar bounces off the ends of the track. Set to zero to stop it bouncing. Applies to your next catch. Default: 100%%.
Click once to lift the catching bar and again to release it, instead of holding the button down. Applies to your next catch. Default: off.
Give yourself more or less warning before a fish makes a sudden move. Only moves that already have a warning are affected. Applies to your next catch. Default: 100%%.
Show which way a fish is about to move when it gives a warning. Default: on.
Keep the catch meter from draining while the bar covers a treasure chest. Applies to your next catch. Default: off.
Adjust how long a treasure chest stays on the track before it disappears. Applies to the next chest. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how long you need to keep the bar over a treasure chest to collect it. Lower values make collection faster. Applies to the next chest. Default: 100%%.
Set how quickly you lose treasure collection progress when the bar moves off the chest. Applies to the next chest. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how fast your drones fly, including the speed they gain from upgrades. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how long your drones chase a target before giving up, including extra time from upgrades. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how fast drones fly back to your fleet. Default: 100%%.
Set the delay between launches when you send out several drones at once. Applies to your next launch. Default: 0.5 seconds.
Adjust the time it takes to regain a harpoon charge. Lower values recharge faster. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how fast your harpoons fly, including the speed they gain from upgrades. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how far you can fire a harpoon, including extra range from upgrades. Default: 100%%.
Adjust the strength of your harpoon's aim assistance. You still need to buy the upgrade for it to work. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how much area your breach lights cover, including any upgrades. The Fisherman's lights are unaffected. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how long your breach lights take to open fully. Applies the next time you turn them on. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how long tracked motes stay visible. You still need to buy the visibility upgrade for it to work. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how often the Needle Sensor gives you a hint while your lights are off. The sensor must be fitted. Default: 100%%.
Make the Needle Sensor's hint rings more or less visible. The sensor must be fitted. Default: 100%%.

Choose a difficulty for hunting legendary fish in space. It takes effect when you save and leaves minigame settings alone. Choose Keep current to keep your individual hunt settings. Default: Keep current.
Adjust how fast legendary fish move in space, including fish you're already hunting. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how often legendary fish create hazards. Hazards already in play are unchanged. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how strongly fishing mines push or pull your fleet. This doesn't affect a star's corona. Default: 100%%.
Adjust the time between a legendary fish's attacks and abilities. Higher values give you more time between them. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how long a hunt stays active after you lose sight of the fish. Turning off your lamps, leaving the system or crossing the fish's boundary can still end it. Default: 100%%.
Failed catches leave scars that make a legendary fish easier to catch next time. Adjust how much those scars help on your next attempt. Default: 100%%.
Let scars from failed catches lower a legendary fish's quality. Turn this off to keep the help they give you without losing quality. Default: on.
Adjust how long the False Dawn's mines last. Mines already in play are unchanged. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how often the False Dawn lays mines. This combines with the general Hazard frequency setting. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how often the Lantern Jack calls fish to feed. Default: 100%%.
Limit how many shield charges the Lantern Jack can hold during a hunt. It starts with up to three. Lowering the limit removes any excess charges immediately. Default: 3.
Adjust how fast the shield segments rotate around the Longliner and its decoys. Default: 100%%.
Set how many decoys accompany the Longliner after you break its first shield segment. Changing this also adds or removes decoys in an existing school. Default: 18.
Adjust how long the Slipstream Moray's trails last, including trails already in space. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how often ordinary fishing jobs appear in bars. Set to zero to stop new offers. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how often fleets offer new fishing jobs. Existing jobs are unchanged. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how often you receive fishing distress calls. Other distress calls are unaffected. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how much time you get to finish new ordinary fishing jobs. Deadlines for jobs you've already accepted stay the same. Default: 100%%.
Remove delivery deadlines from new ordinary fishing jobs. Story events that depend on timing still run as usual. Default: off.
Set how many days you must wait after finishing a job for the Fisherman before he offers another. Default: 90 days.
Set how many days the temporary fishing conditions described in a new rumor will last. Default: 60 days.
Show cyan markers beside fleets offering fishing jobs. You can still ask for work if the markers are hidden. Default: on.
Show yellow markers for fleet jobs you've accepted, including map indicators when the fleet is outside radar range. Default: on.
Show the Fisherman's map indicator when he's outside radar range. Default: on.
Mark the rupture assigned to a quest. Hiding the marker doesn't change where or what you need to catch. Default: on.
Show a notification when a catch makes progress on a fishing quest you've accepted. Default: on.
Show notifications for new and expiring fishing rumors. These stay hidden if Important notifications only is turned on. Default: on.
Adjust the number of ordinary fish hidden in space and how often they emerge from ruptures. Changes take effect as fish are replenished. This doesn't add more legendary fish. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how quickly ordinary fish are replaced. Each species still only appears in its usual habitats. Default: 100%%.

Hidden fish surface as soon as a breach light reaches them and swim in their own style until caught or gone. Epic and legendary fish stay hidden until harpooned. When off, every hidden fish stays hidden until harpooned. Default: on.

Speed of fish that surface in your breach lights, as a percentage of their normal speed in ruptures. Each species keeps its own pace relative to the others. Lower values make them easier to chase. Only applies while Surface fish in breach lights is on. Changes apply at once. Default: 100.

Fish that surface in your breach lights swim a straight course with a gentle weave, as hidden fish do, instead of their species' movement pattern of darts, stalls, curves and dives. Only applies while Surface fish in breach lights is on; turn that off to keep fish hidden until harpooned. Changes apply at once. Default: off.
Adjust how many unstable patches are placed when a system is first populated. Systems already populated are unchanged. Default: 100%%.
Allow patrols to confront you over breach-light use. Turning this off won't end a confrontation already in progress. Default: on.
Adjust how quickly repeated breach-light offences lead to harsher patrol responses. Changes apply the next time a patrol checks your record. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how quickly the camera moves to an opening pond. Only applies while Snap viewport to open ponds is on. Default: 100%%.
Start with the coherence overlay turned on in the fishing map. You can still switch it on or off in the map itself. Default: off.
Adjust the credit cost of upgrades. Refunds for upgrades you've already bought keep their original value. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how many fish upgrades cost. The number is rounded up, with a minimum of one fish. Default: 100%%.
Adjust the credit cost of equipment in the Outfitter. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how many fish the Fisherman charges for range data. The number is rounded up, with a minimum of one fish. Default: 100%%.
Adjust the credit rewards for new fishing jobs. Existing offers keep their rewards. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how distorted low-coherence fish look in the aquarium. Set to zero to display them without distortion. Default: 100%%.
Make low-coherence aquarium fish break up into pixels and displaced strips. Default: on.
Adjust how fast fish swim in the aquarium. This has no effect on catching them. Default: 100%%.
Brighten or darken your chosen aquarium background. Default: 100%%.
Adjust the amount of decorative particles in the aquarium. Default: 100%%.
Adjust minigame sound effects. Fishing sound volume also affects these sounds. Default: 100%%.
Adjust drone, harpoon and breach-light sounds. Fishing sound volume also affects these sounds. Default: 100%%.
Adjust sound effects during legendary hunts. Fishing sound volume also affects these sounds. Default: 100%%.
Set the volume of the fishing loop while you're not lifting the catching bar. Fishing sound volume and Minigame sound volume also apply. Default: 10%%.
Set the volume of the fishing loop while you lift the catching bar. Fishing sound volume and Minigame sound volume also apply. Default: 30%%.
Play a click when you press the mouse button to control the catching bar. Default: on.
Play a sound when the fish leaves the catching bar. Default: on.
Play sounds when treasure appears and when you collect it. Default: on.
Set how much of your current music volume to keep while fishing. The previous volume returns when you close the minigame. Default: 50%%.
Adjust the strength of the coherence effect around the edges of the screen. Default: 100%%.
Adjust how much fishing effects warp the campaign view. Default: 100%%.
Tone down flashes and blackouts during hunts. Fish still switch positions and give the same warnings. Default: off.
Adjust how much confetti appears when you catch a fish. Hazards and their hitboxes are unaffected. Default: 100%%.
Show messages when the Lantern Jack calls fish to feed. Turning this off leaves hit and shield messages visible. Default: on.
